title: Tor intervals survive slice restriction
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site small in the chosen universe [def-weil-size-convention], where $\mathcal O$ is a sheaf of commutative rings, and use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and their unbounded derived category $D(\mathcal O)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the derived tensor product computed by K-flat resolutions [def-pc-kflat-complex, lem-weil-pbc-site-derived-tensor-descent] and cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Let $a\le b$ be integers and $E\in D(\mathcal O)$ satisfy $H^r(E\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O}F)=0$ for every $\mathcal O$-module sheaf $F$ in degree zero and every $r\notin[a,b]$. For every object $U\in\mathcal C$, let $E|_U$ be its derived restriction [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-derived-restriction] to the localized ringed site $(\mathcal C/U,\mathcal O_U)$ [def-pur-localized-ringed-site]. Then $H^r(E|_U\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_U}G)=0$ for every $\mathcal O_U$-module sheaf $G$ in degree zero and every $r\notin[a,b]$.

source.place: Tag 08H5 (lemma-tor-amplitude-pullback), specialized to the localization morphism of a ringed site; restriction is exact, so its derived pullback is ordinary restriction.

proof.text: Apply the forward implication of [lem-sp-ringed-site-tor-flat-model] to the given universal Tor interval. Obtain a complex P of site-flat module sheaves, zero outside [a,b], and E ≅ Q(P). This is the same Stacks 08G1 bounded-flat-model step as the original route, using its existing ringed-site specialization instead of rebuilding the categorical tensor identification.

Let F be restriction to C/U, exact by [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact], and let B be its termwise application to P. The natural comparison siteSheafTensorRightIso of [lem-weil-pbc-independent-sheaf-tensor-colimits] identifies explicit site tensor with the monoidal tensor. Transfer flatness along this isomorphism, use [lem-weil-pbc-slice-restriction-flat] termwise, and transfer back on the slice. Hence B has site-flat terms. Exact restriction preserves zero objects, so B is zero outside [a,b].

Mathlib Functor.mapDerivedCategory for the exact functor F and Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors give the representative comparison. Apply the induced functor to Q(Q.objPreimage E) ≅ E ≅ Q(P). Compose with the inverse comparison at Q.objPreimage E and the comparison at P. This yields E|U ≅ Q_U(B) for the canonical representative definition [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-derived-restriction]. The construction permits distinct derived Hom universes w and w'.

The reverse implication of [lem-sp-ringed-site-tor-flat-model] on C/U applies to B, its site-flat terms, the same zero bounds, and E|U ≅ Q_U(B). It gives the required vanishing against every module sheaf G on C/U; no extension of G from the original site is assumed.
